blocks.text: PRIME Minister of India, the Honorable Shri Narendra Modi, on Tuesday paid a historic visit to the Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara, the oldest Sikh shrine in the country, which is undergoing redevelopment under the auspices of Khalsa Diwan, Inc. Philippines, president Manjinder “James” Kumar, who is also the head of the Filipino-Indian Commerce and Welfare Society, Inc. (FICWSI). Currently in the country to attend the ASEAN Summit meetings, PM Modi honored Kumar’s invitation to grace the laying of the foundation stone for the redevelopment of the oldest Sikh shrine located in Paco, Manila, which, for over a century now, has symbolized the […]...
